mapper.select: SELECT studentid, total_points AS totalPoints, level, continuous_days AS continuousDays, last_checkin AS lastCheckin, update_time AS updateTime FROM student_points WHERE studentid = #{studentid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_points (studentid, total_points, level, continuous_days, update_time) VALUES (#{studentid}, #{delta}, 1, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_points = total_points + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE student_points SET level = #{level} WHERE studentid = #{studentid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_log (studentid, points, type, reason, create_time) VALUES (#{studentid}, #{points}, #{type}, #{reason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, description, icon, condition_type AS conditionType, threshold FROM badge_def ORDER BY threshold ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO student_badge (studentid, badge_code, obtain_time) VALUES (#{studentid}, #{code}, NOW())
